# Fallback only. On the apex worker (`openmarket`, root wrangler.toml) /robots.txt is
# forwarded to the API, which generates it with the sitemap URLs for PUBLIC_STOREFRONT_URL
# (apps/storefront/edge/apex-worker.js). This static copy is what the warm-spare
# `olmoa-storefront` worker serves; it carries no host so it can never point at a stale one.

Disallow: /checkout
Disallow: /orders
Disallow: /profile
Disallow: /addresses
